In an ecosystem, energy enters mainly through producers that convert sunlight into chemical energy.
That energy passes to consumers through feeding relationships.
My favorite example is a documentary about wolves in Yellowstone.
At each transfer, much of the energy is lost as heat, so food chains usually contain only a few levels.
Decomposers return nutrients to the environment, although they do not restore the lost energy.
